caseNames: the schema declares every span Chord starts and keeps ids off metrics
the schema declares every metric a traced call over a relay records
nothing recorded treats the NOOP context as untraced: no carrier, its own root
nothing recorded records nothing and sends no carrier when no host has an adapter
carriers extracts an unknown or absent carrier as the adapter's root, never throwing
open spans ends once, with how its work settled: ok, a cancel (status ok), or an error with its category
open spans marks a span failed with a fixed category and at most 500 characters
metrics makes each instrument once per adapter's metrics and none for NOOP
metrics keeps no adapter alive (its instruments are cached by its metrics object, weakly)
across hosts follows a call from the tab through the server's relay into the worker's method and its commit
across hosts names the host that recorded each span: its address key, `client` without an address
across hosts holds through the relay under the tab's span; the worker's start and its activations link to their triggers
across hosts costs a call over a relay exactly its spans and no extra encode
across hosts starts a new root for a well-formed carrier the server's adapter does not know
re-holds (slice 9 review L1) carries the carrier only on an object's first hold (a root linked to its getter: shared work); a re-hold after a reconnect is a fresh root linked to it
relayed re-holds (slice 9 review L1) re-holds upstream after a drop in a fresh relay root linked to the first relay span
what a peer sends (slice 9 review M1, M2, L8) refuses a 500,000-character type as a malformed header: the link closes, nothing is recorded
what a peer sends (slice 9 review M1, M2, L8) refuses a 257-character host kind as a malformed header: the link closes, nothing is recorded
what a peer sends (slice 9 review M1, M2, L8) refuses a carrier with a control character as a malformed header: the link closes, nothing is recorded
what a peer sends (slice 9 review M1, M2, L8) refuses a carrier key with a space as a malformed header: the link closes, nothing is recorded
what a peer sends (slice 9 review M1, M2, L8) refuses a carrier of 9 keys as a malformed header: the link closes, nothing is recorded
what a peer sends (slice 9 review M1, M2, L8) refuses a carrier value of 257 characters as a malformed header: the link closes, nothing is recorded
what a peer sends (slice 9 review M1, M2, L8) caps an object's label (its client-chosen params key) at 256 characters in its spans
